name: dobe_nelson_key
desc: Clean this rough into finished pixel art without changing the composition: a full nelson. The huge pink paint goo Doberman stands behind the small black witch cat; its thick goo arms come from behind under the cat's armpits (visible on both sides of the cat's body) and its hands are locked behind the cat's head. The cat has only TWO arms: both forced straight up and hooked over the monster's arms, paws helpless in the air; remove the cat's other arms and the paintbrush. The cat dangles above the puddle, struggling: eyes squeezed shut, mouth open, legs kicking, hat askew, sticky pink goo smeared on its body and dripping. The Doberman's head is above the cat's hat, leering down with a sly smirk and stern yellow eyes. Same colors, marble streaks, outline and pixel art style as the monster. Transparent background.
